fixes.explanation: Elijah says to Ahab, king of Israel, “As surely as the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there will be neither dew nor rain in these years except at my word!” (1 Kings 17:1) My big announcements are usually “the cookies are DONE,” and even those make me nervous, friend. This one is about the whole sky.
